label: Evolved line animation (video)
description: George's full cake animation (cake-ascent-30s) cut into chapters, one per slot. Hero: the whole 30 s on the dark hero. Step 1 (0-10 s): the data point and data frame. Step 2 (10-17 s): the layers stacking. Step 3 (17-23 s): the AI frosting dropping onto the top tier. Shortlist (23-30 s): the finished cake. Clips on white modules are colour-inverted in the file. Tuner: press T.
